Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 11: the slip of [[Mace Windu (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Mace's game text may not be canceled (except at Senate). During battle, Mace may fire one weapon twice. Boba Fett may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition.”), word for word the text of [[Mace Windu (V) (Virtual Block 5)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
